title: Harvesting Insights From Conversations
definition: The process of extracting meaningful ideas and observations from conversations and incorporating them into a knowledge system.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Harvesting insights is like gathering wisdom from conversations and adding it to a collection of knowledge.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Harvesting insights from conversations involves extracting new concepts using a structured approach with a well-defined prompt.
difficulty_levels.expert: Harvesting insights from conversations is a novel contribution to knowledge management and LLM-assisted concept extraction, connecting to the broader field of human-computer interaction.

extra_fields.insight: The process of extracting and incorporating new concepts into a knowledge system from conversations is a novel and valuable contribution to the field.
